Orchards Academy Open Evening
We are hiring! Please Visit our Vacancies Page
Welcome to Orchards Academy
Our curriculum is the heartbeat of our educational vision, designed to empower every student to become a confident, knowledgeable, and impactful individual ready to navigate and shape the world.
Instagram @orchards.tkat
Hard work pays off: It’s officially a record-breaking results day at Orchards! 🏆 Our Year 11 students have officially delivered a record-breaking set of GCSE results, achieving the highest average grade in the school’s history! Driven by a massive surge in top Grades 9–7, particularly across Maths, Science, History, and the Arts, our students have set a brand-new standard for academic achievement. Huge congratulations to the entire Year 11 cohort with a special shoutout to some of our top individual achievers! 🎉👏 🌟 Grateful: Achieved an incredible 5 Grade 9s across Maths, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Computer Science. 🌟 Lillie: Scored a Grade 9 in History, Double 8 in English, and 7-8-7 in Triple Science. 🌟 Jude: Earned top grades across English Literature, History, Geography, and English Language. 🌟 Callum: Secured a Grade 7 or better across 5 key subjects.
We rounded off an incredible Sports Week with a fantastic trip to St Andrews Lake today. Thank you to our brilliant PE Department for putting together such an excellent week! The end of Sports Week also marks the end of this academic year! We would like to wish everyone a wonderful, safe summer break! ☀️😎 A reminder of our return dates for September 2026: 🗓️ 2nd September: Open to new Year 7s ONLY 🗓️ 3rd September: All students return
Day 4 of sports week saw a trip to Hollywood Bowl yesterday! 🎳
A picture-perfect day out for our Year 10 Photography students yesterday as they enjoyed a visit to the National Portrait Gallery. 🖼️📸
Yesterday was day 3 of Sports Week and students enjoyed a trip to @ballerz_official, they had a fantastic time and represented the school excellently! ⚽️🥅
Well done to Elliot in Year 9, who had a brilliant time at the Kent Music Benenden Experience Day last week! He enjoyed a day of musical activities and workshops, wrapping it up with a wonderful performance in the concert at the end of the day. 🎶✨
A busy morning in Science for Year 9, who spent their lessons dissecting lamb hearts! 🔬🫀
Day 2 of Sports Week saw students spend the day tackling the obstacles at Ninja Warrior yesterday! 🥷💥
What a brilliant Sports Day yesterday - the absolute perfect way to kick off Sports Week and to unveil our brand new astro pitch! 🏆☀️ Huge congratulations to our winners Farah! 🎉
A huge thank you to @britishtransportpolice for coming into school to deliver rail safety assemblies to our students today.
Last night, we celebrated our incredible students at our OVERS (Orchards Values Excellence Rewards) Show. We are so proud of everyone's hard work, dedication, and achievements this year. 🏆 A massive congratulations to our Student of the Year award winners: 📐 Maths: Glory 📚 English: Erin 🔬 Science: Lola 🏰 History: Talya 🌍 Geography: Isla 📸 Photography: Megan 🛠️ Design & Technology: Alin 🎨 Art: Taylor-Lily 🎭 Drama: Brandon 🎵 Music: Sonny 🏃‍♂️⚽ PE: Ted & Macy 🍳 Food: Mia 🙏 RE: Ellie 🇪🇸 Spanish: Gianna 💻 Computer Science: James
Well done to our Year 10s who have just returned from their work experience week! We have been absolutely overwhelmed by the fantastic feedback from so many employers - well done Year 10 on making such a brilliant impression out in the working world. 🌟👏 A massive thank you goes out to the many local businesses who supported these placements. We truly appreciate you opening your doors, sharing your expertise, and investing your time in our students!
Huge shoutout to the wonderful Year 6 students who joined us today for our Transition Day! 🌟 You all brought so much energy, curiosity, and big smiles with you and we loved getting to know you all! Roll on September! 🏫
Year 7 Humanities students enjoyed a visit to the Natural History Museum yesterday, exploring exhibits on dinosaurs, earthquakes, volcanoes and mammals. A fantastic day of discovery that complemented their learning beyond the classroom 🦖🌋
Incredible experience yesterday at the district sports day! 🏆 Our students did us proud demonstrating incredible sportsmanship, resilience and determination. We are so proud of them all!
Last week, our Year 10 GCSE students visited The National Archives in Kew. To support their studies on the Western Front, they examined original WWI medical records and Wilfred Owen’s personal military files. A fantastic opportunity to connect with real history! 🎖️
Important Notice: Due to the extremely high temperatures forecast for tomorrow, Friday 26th June, the school will be closed to all students🌡️🚨☀️
Huge thanks to Captain Daren Slack for inspiring our Year 7s this morning! 👨‍✈️ A pilot of 32 years, he shared his journey, top tips for fulfilling potential, and a reminder that the sky is the limit for everyone ✈️✨
Before the temperatures soared this week, we were delighted to host Bonus Pastor Catholic College for a Year 8 and 9 handball fixture. It was an amazing fixture, and our students secured the win by demonstrating excellent skill and determination throughout.🤾‍♂️🏆 Special congratulations to Jayden, who was named the Opposition Player of the Match 👏
Important Notice: With the extreme heat forecast over the next three days, we are putting several temporary measures in place to ensure the safety, comfort, and well-being of our students, including closing early from Wednesday 24th - Friday 26th June 🌡️🚨☀️

English
Our curriculum is characterised by a high quality knowledge rich education, including the cultural capital that will help them realise their ambitions in school and beyond.
We teach all the different elements of English through a spiralised curriculum that builds on prior learning and students to think critically in opinion, analysis and argument. Our thematic curriculum is ambitious and challenging, interleaving analytical and structural skills throughout a variety of media and contexts.
Our spiralised structure combines learning in key genres combined with reinforcing literacy skills and experiencing a range of reading texts.This enables our students to gain, recall and apply their learning to new and more challenging work as they progress throughout the key stages. Our intent is also for students to become articulate and confident public speakers, ones that are ready for the rigours of interview in a modern day society.
The curriculum in Years 10 and 11 is focused on securing the best outcomes for our students. by continuing with a thematic scheme, one that is interleaved intelligently with elements of poetry and creative writing, so that skills are developed in a variety of contexts.
Students are given ample opportunity to reflect on how they can improve on previous work, with factored time for implementing redraft and reflection on key skills within the subject.

PE
At Orchards we believe that pupils develop competence and excellence in a broad range of activities with an ambitious curriculum offer.
Our pupils are physically active during physical education lessons and they have opportunities to extend their activity levels during extra curricular clubs and in the wider community.
Links to careers in sport and the physical activity sector are referenced throughout. Lessons are sequenced so that skills and techniques are reinforced and revisited across different scenarios, feedback is given to students to develop performance and understanding of technique and strategies used in the activity.
Orchards Academy pupils engage in healthy competition at intra and inter school competition.
We encourage our pupils to lead active and healthy lifestyles that support positive physical and mental health.

Personal Development
Our Personal Development Curriculum: Nurturing Character, Fostering Future-Ready Citizens
At Orchards Academy, we understand that a truly exceptional education extends far beyond academic achievement. Our comprehensive Personal Development (PD) curriculum is designed to cultivate well-rounded individuals who are confident, resilient, and prepared for the complexities of modern life. This curriculum is meticulously planned to meet and exceed the expectations of the Department for Education (DfE) and Ofsted, ensuring that every student develops the essential knowledge, skills, and attributes to thrive as active and responsible citizens.
Meeting DfE and Ofsted Expectations:
Our PD curriculum is a cornerstone of our commitment to providing a broad and balanced education that promotes students' spiritual, moral, social, and cultural (SMSC) development. It explicitly addresses Ofsted's focus on the "personal development" judgement, demonstrating how we:
Statutory Relationships, Sex, and Health Education (RSE):
Integrated seamlessly within our PD curriculum is the statutory Relationships, Sex, and Health Education (RSE). This vital component ensures that our students receive age-appropriate, factual, and sensitive education on:
Our RSE provision is delivered in a safe, inclusive environment, allowing students to ask questions and develop the understanding and confidence to make informed decisions about their health and relationships. It aligns with our school's values of Considerate and Responsible behaviour, promoting respect for self and others.
Key Themes and Content:
Our PD curriculum covers a wide array of essential themes, delivered through dedicated lessons, assemblies, external speakers, and cross-curricular links:
Delivery and Impact:
The PD curriculum is delivered through a dedicated timetable slot, ensuring consistent and progressive learning. Furthermore, its principles are reinforced across all subjects and through our vertical house system, which provides a practical context for developing leadership, teamwork, and a sense of collective responsibility.
By nurturing the body as well as the mind, and by grounding our programmes in real-world applications, our Personal Development curriculum at Orchards Academy ensures that students not only gain knowledge but also develop the character, values, and life skills necessary to lead fulfilling lives and make a positive impact on their communities and the wider world. It is integral to our unwavering belief that all of our students are capable of greatness.
